newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Snyder to accept Cairn bid for Command.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Snyder to accept Cairn bid for Command.

text.p: Command Petroleum Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that its major shareholder, Snyder Oil Corp, would accept the takeover bid for Command by U.K.-based Cairn Energy Plc.
Snyder, which owns about 32.6 percent of Command, said it had elected to take Cairn shares under the terms of the takeover, which includes a cash offer.
Cairn said in a separate statement that its bid had been approved by the Australian government's Foreign Investment Review Board.
The bid closes on November 22, with Command's board of directors recommending acceptance.
Cairn said it held 19.9 percent of Command. It has offered A$1.10 per Command share or two Cairn shares for every 13 Command shares. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
